changelog:
✨ New Features
• Debugging: Block/force offline feature flags
• Downloads: Add album and playlist downloads
• Third-party lyrics: Add reactive dynamic background layout refinements, and automatic ruby generation
• Hide layout components: Add "Hide GIF button" and "Hide GIFs and images" comment settings
• Add playlist creation from downloaded music tracks
• GmsCore support: Support video/audio casting to other devices (Requires latest MicroG-RE)

🌟 Mod Features
• All Morphe patches for YouTube Music
• Customizable preset settings
• Extra clone variant with Dynamic Island on supported devices
• In-app update check for new builds

🐛 Bug Fixes
• Non-experimental targets do not patch
• Spoof video streams: Do not block get_watch, initplayback, or Onesie requests
• Downloads: Downloading with flyout menu shows premium popup
• Downloads: Downloads screen freezes with a large catalogue
• Downloads: Offline playback crashes with a large queue
• Spoof video streams: Video opened from the search results can load forever when another video is fetched at the same time
• Downloads: Offline playback audio focus handling
• Hide flyout menu components: Fix patching 9.44.52
• Settings: App crashes when opening settings with 9.44.52
• Third-party lyrics: Various minor bug fixes
